title: TDD Best Practices
description: Master test-driven development and testing strategies.

data.text: TDD writes tests before code. Red-green-refactor cycle improves design and reduces bugs.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: TDD: write test, make it pass, refactor
data.takeaway: TDD improves code quality through the red-green-refactor cycle. Use it for business logic where the design benefits are clear.
